name: IC 3612 (Hubble)
blurb: IC 3612, a dwarf early-type galaxy in the Virgo Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: ic3612-hubble
story: IC 3612 is a small galaxy in the Virgo Cluster, one of 100 early-type galaxies Hubble surveyed to study their globular star clusters, their shapes and their distances.

claims.text: VCC 1779 is IC 3612, a dwarf S0 (dwarf early-type) galaxy
The ACS Virgo Cluster Survey imaged 100 early-type galaxies in the Virgo Cluster
The survey's goals include globular clusters, galaxy isophotes (shapes) and distances
